privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content: This Privacy Policy explains how Bibliboo ("we", "us", or "our") collects, uses, and protects your information when you use our Service.<return></return><return></return><title>1. Information We Collect</title>Email Address (Required):<return></return>• Email address for book delivery (PDF files)<return></return>• Used for communication about your order<return></return><return></return>Account Information (Optional):<return></return>• If you choose to create an account:<return></return>  ▪ Email address and password (encrypted), OR<return></return>  ▪ Google authentication credentials<return></return>  ▪ Account creation date<return></return>  ▪ History of books you've generated<return></return><return></return>Payment Information:<return></return>• Payment information is processed by third-party payment providers<return></return>• We do not store full credit card or banking details<return></return>• We may store transaction history for your purchases<return></return><return></return>Content Data:<return></return>• Books you create (text, images, metadata)<return></return>• AI prompts and preferences you submit<return></return>• Books are not listed publicly, but anyone who has a book's link can open it<return></return><return></return>Technical Information:<return></return>• Device type and operating system<return></return>• App version<return></return>• IP address<return></return>• Usage statistics and crash reports<return></return>• Log files and error messages<return></return><return></return><title>2. How We Use Your Information</title>We use collected information to:<return></return>• Provide and maintain the Service<return></return>• Process your one-time payments for book generation<return></return>• Generate AI-powered books based on your inputs<return></return>• Deliver PDF books to your email address<return></return>• Store your created books (if you have an account)<return></return>• Communicate with you about your orders and the Service<return></return>• Improve and optimize the Service<return></return>• Detect and prevent fraud or abuse<return></return>• Comply with legal obligations<return></return><return></return><title>3. AI and Data Processing</title>• Your prompts and inputs are processed by artificial intelligence systems<return></return>• AI providers may process your data according to their own privacy policies<return></return>• We do not use your personal information to train AI models without consent<return></return>• Generated content is stored on our servers<return></return>• Books are delivered as PDF files via email<return></return><return></return><title>4. Information Sharing</title>We do not sell or share your personal information. We may share your information only with:<return></return><return></return>Third-Party Service Providers:<return></return>• Payment processors (for payment processing)<return></return>• AI service providers (for book generation)<return></return>• Cloud hosting services (for data storage)<return></return>• Email delivery services (for sending PDF books)<return></return>• Analytics providers (for Service improvement)<return></return><return></return>These providers are contractually obligated to protect your information and use it only to provide services to us.<return></return><return></return>Legal Requirements:<return></return>• We may disclose information if required by law<return></return>• To protect our rights, safety, or property<return></return>• To investigate fraud or violations of our Terms<return></return><return></return>What We Don't Share:<return></return>• Your books are never shared publicly<return></return>• Other users cannot access your books<return></return>• Your email address is never shared with other users<return></return>• Your personal information is never sold to third parties<return></return><return></return><title>5. Data Storage and Security</title>• Your data is stored on secure servers<return></return>• We use industry-standard encryption for sensitive data<return></return>• Passwords are encrypted and not accessible to us<return></return>• Email communications are sent through secure channels<return></return>• We cannot guarantee absolute security but take reasonable measures to protect your information<return></return>• PDF files delivered to your email are your responsibility to secure<return></return><return></return><title>6. Children's Privacy</title>• The Service is available to users of all ages<return></return>• We do not knowingly collect more information from children than necessary to provide the Service<return></return>• Parents and guardians are responsible for monitoring their children's use<return></return>• Parents may request access to or deletion of their child's data by contacting us<return></return><return></return><title>7. Your Rights</title>Under Swiss and European data protection law, you have the right to:<return></return>• Access your personal information<return></return>• Correct inaccurate information<return></return>• Delete your account and associated data<return></return>• Export your data in a portable format<return></return>• Withdraw consent for data processing<return></return>• Object to certain types of processing<return></return>• Lodge a complaint with data protection authorities<return></return><return></return>To exercise these rights, contact us at {email}<return></return><return></return><title>8. Data Retention</title>• Without an account: We retain your email address and transaction information only as long as necessary to deliver your book and for legal/accounting purposes<return></return>• With an account: We retain your information for as long as your account is active<return></return>• After account deletion, we delete your personal information within 30 days<return></return>• Transaction records may be retained longer for legal, tax, or security purposes<return></return>• Anonymized data may be retained for analytics<return></return>• PDF files sent to your email are stored by your email provider according to their policies<return></return><return></return><title>9. Cookies and Tracking</title>• We may use cookies and similar technologies to improve the Service<return></return>• Cookies help us remember your preferences and login status (if you have an account)<return></return>• You can disable cookies in your browser settings, but this may affect functionality<return></return>• We do not use advertising or tracking cookies<return></return>• We do not track your activity outside of our Service<return></return><return></return><title>10. Third-Party Links</title>• The Service may contain links to third-party websites or services<return></return>• We are not responsible for the privacy practices of third parties<return></return>• We encourage you to review their privacy policies<return></return><return></return><title>11. International Data Transfers</title>• Your information may be transferred to and processed in countries outside Switzerland<return></return>• We ensure appropriate safeguards are in place for such transfers<return></return>• By using the Service, you consent to such transfers<return></return><return></return><title>12. Email Communications</title>• We send transactional emails to deliver your PDF books<return></return>• We may send service-related emails (order confirmations, account updates, changes to Terms, etc.)<return></return>• You cannot opt out of service-related communications necessary to provide the Service<return></return>• We do not send marketing emails unless you opt in<return></return>• You can unsubscribe from marketing emails at any time<return></return><return></return><title>13. Account vs. No Account</title>Without an Account:<return></return>• We only collect your email address for book delivery<return></return>• You receive your PDF via email<return></return>• We do not retain access to your generated book after delivery (beyond backup/legal requirements)<return></return>• You are responsible for saving your PDF<return></return><return></return>With an Account:<return></return>• You can access all your previously generated books<return></return>• Your books are stored securely in your account<return></return>• You can delete your account and all associated data at any time<return></return><return></return><title>15. privacy.children: <title>Your child's information</title>To create a book we use your child's first name, age, gender, appearance (hair, eye and skin colour) and your story idea. We never ask for a photo of your child.<return></return><return></return>These details are sent to our AI providers (OpenAI and Google, through OpenRouter) only to write the story and draw the illustrations. Story ideas are also checked by OpenAI's moderation service, and read-aloud audio is created with OpenAI.<return></return><return></return>Other providers we use: Stripe (payments), Resend (emails) and Amazon Web Services (storage). Some of these providers process data outside Switzerland, including in the USA.<return></return><return></return>We keep your book and the details used to create it so you can download it again. You can delete a book at any time from your account, or ask us at {email} to delete it.<return></return><return></return>Under the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (FADP) you can ask us what data we hold about you and have it corrected or deleted. You can also contact the Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner (FDPIC).

refund.title: Refund and Cancellation Policy
refund.description: View our Refund and Cancellation Policy
refund.content: This Refund and Cancellation Policy applies to all purchases made through Bibliboo ("we", "us", or "our"). By making a purchase, you agree to this policy.<return></return><return></return><title>1. No Refund Policy</title>All sales are final. Due to the digital nature of our Service and immediate delivery of AI-generated books, we do not offer refunds, exchanges, or cancellations once:<return></return>• Payment has been successfully processed, AND<return></return>• Your book generation has been initiated<return></return><return></return><title>2. Why We Don't Offer Refunds</title>Bibliboo provides custom AI-generated digital content that is:<return></return>• Instantly created based on your unique inputs<return></return>• Immediately delivered to your email as a PDF file<return></return>• Non-returnable digital goods that cannot be "un-used"<return></return>• Custom-made specifically for you and cannot be resold<return></return><return></return>Once your book is generated and delivered, the service has been fully rendered.<return></return><return></return><title>3. Pre-Purchase Considerations</title>Before completing your purchase, please:<return></return>• ✓ Review your prompts, themes, and character information carefully<return></return>• ✓ Verify your email address is correct<return></return>• ✓ Understand that AI-generated content may vary in quality and style<return></return>• ✓ Confirm you agree to our Terms of Service<return></return>• ✓ Ensure you understand that all sales are final<return></return><return></return>Once you click "Generate" or "Purchase," you acknowledge that you cannot cancel or request a refund.<return></return><return></return><title>4. Technical Issues and Exceptions</title>We may provide a refund or regeneration only in the following limited circumstances:<return></return><return></return><title>4.1 Payment Errors</title>• You were charged multiple times for the same book due to a technical error<return></return>• You were charged but no book generation was initiated<return></return>• The charged amount was incorrect due to a system error<return></return><return></return>Action: Contact us within 48 hours of the transaction with proof of the error.<return></return><return></return><title>4.2 Delivery Failures</title>• Your book was not delivered to your email due to a technical issue on our end<return></return>• The PDF file is corrupted and cannot be opened<return></return><return></return>Action: Contact us within 7 days of purchase with:<return></return>• Your order confirmation or transaction ID<return></return>• The email address you used<return></return>• Description of the issue<return></return><return></return>Resolution: We will resend your book or regenerate it. Refunds will only be issued if we cannot resolve the delivery issue.<return></return><return></return><title>4.3 Service Outages</title>• Our Service was completely unavailable and your payment was processed but no book was generated<return></return><return></return>Action: Contact us within 7 days with your transaction details.<return></return><return></return><title>5. What is NOT Eligible for Refunds</title>You are not entitled to a refund if:<return></return>• ❌ You are dissatisfied with the AI-generated content, style, or quality<return></return>• ❌ You made a typo in your prompts or character names<return></return>• ❌ The AI interpretation differs from your expectations<return></return>• ❌ You entered an incorrect email address and did not receive your book<return></return>• ❌ Your email provider blocked or filtered our delivery email (check spam/junk folders)<return></return>• ❌ You no longer want the book after it has been generated<return></return>• ❌ You changed your mind after purchase<return></return>• ❌ You accidentally made a duplicate purchase (please check carefully before purchasing again)<return></return>• ❌ You violated our Terms of Service<return></return><return></return><title>6. Cancellations</title>Before Payment is Processed:<return></return>You may cancel your order before clicking the final "Purchase" or "Pay" button.<return></return><return></return>After Payment is Processed:<return></return>Cancellations are not possible once payment has been processed and book generation has begun. The process is automated and immediate.<return></return><return></return><title>7. Chargebacks and Disputes</title>Unauthorized Chargebacks:<return></return>• If you file a chargeback or payment dispute without first contacting us, we reserve the right to:<return></return>  ▪ Suspend or terminate your account<return></return>  ▪ Ban you from future use of the Service<return></return>  ▪ Pursue legal action for fraud<return></return><return></return>Legitimate Disputes:<return></return>• Please contact us first at {email} before initiating a chargeback<return></return>• We will work with you in good faith to resolve legitimate issues<return></return>• Keep records of your transaction and communication with us<return></return><return></return><title>8. How to Request a Refund (Exceptional Cases Only)</title>If you believe you qualify for a refund under Section 4, contact us with:<return></return>Email: {email}<return></return><return></return>Include:<return></return>1. Your full name<return></return>2. Email address used for purchase<return></return>3. Transaction ID or order confirmation<return></return>4. Date and time of purchase<return></return>5. Detailed description of the technical issue<return></return>6. Screenshots or proof of the problem (if applicable)<return></return><return></return>Response Time:<return></return>• We will respond within 5-7 business days<return></return>• Approved refunds will be processed within 14 days<return></return>• Refunds will be issued to the original payment method<return></return><return></return><title>9. Consumer Rights</title>Swiss Law:<return></return>Under Swiss consumer protection law, digital content that is immediately delivered and cannot be returned is generally exempt from standard withdrawal rights.<return></return><return></return>EU Customers (if applicable):<return></return>By purchasing and initiating the immediate generation and delivery of digital content, you explicitly agree to waive your right of withdrawal under EU Consumer Rights Directive Article 16(m).<return></return><return></return>You acknowledge that:<return></return>• The service begins immediately upon purchase<return></return>• Digital content is delivered immediately<return></return>• You waive your right to a 14-day cooling-off period<return></return><return></return><title>10. Modifications to This Policy</title>We reserve the right to update this Refund Policy at any time. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated "Effective Date." Your continued use of the Service constitutes acceptance of any changes.<return></return><return></return><title>11. Contact Us</title>For refund requests, questions, or concerns:<return></return>Email: {email}<return></return>Website: {website}<return></return><return></return>Please allow 5-7 business days for a response.
